limitations: Interim completion-conditioned cohort; long pending runs are not represented.
Same selected jobs/definition proofs do not prove identical test inputs or queue conditions.

matched_success_comparison.decision: Retain twelve packs and both weights. The repeated hosted cost is in FIF primary commands; no additional source optimization is justified without a new discriminating residual profile and current carrier-custody check. Publish the fixed comparison without claiming causal speedup or cost neutrality.
